blank.hundreds: No {squares} left. We don’t write a zero in front.

lines.tapSquare: Not enough {loose}, and no {rows}. {Spread} a {square}: tap it.

zero.tens: Careful. That zero became ten {rows}, then gave one away. Nine {rows} now.

flip.tensZero: Careful: it’s {top} {takeAway} {bottom}, the top {takeAway} the bottom. No {rows}. Not enough.

nospread.tens: {Top} {takeAway} {bottom}? Not enough {rows}. But we can {spread} a {square}.
nospread.onesZero: No {loose} to take {bottom} from? But we can {spread} a {row}.
